answer_1.quote: Neural methods for abstractive summarization formulate summarization as a sequence-to-sequence (Seq2Seq) problem

answer_2.quote: The candidate quality measure M can be defined in many ways. In this work we define it as the ROUGE score of a candidate summary S_i given the reference summary S^*

answer_3.quote: We assign the abstractive model a dual role - a single model could be used both as a generation model and a reference-free evaluation model
